description: Use when you need a geographic snapshot of where prediction-market attention is concentrated. Returns per-country heat for the current moment (`at=now`) or a past hour (`at=<ISO8601>`). A country's heat is the sum, over its markets that moved in the last 24 hours, of each market's news score |Δprob in points| × log10(1 + 24h volume in USD terms, Manifold mana at 0.01), capped at 100 per market. Volume fields are venue-reported and mix units (shares, contracts, unconverted mana): an order of magnitude, not dollars.

at.description: 'now' (live cache) or an ISO-8601 timestamp for a past hourly frame.
at.title: At

source.description: Restrict to one source (only honored when at=now): polymarket, kalshi, manifold, myriad, limitless, predict, opinion, gemini.
source.title: Source

name: map_heat
title: Country heat map
